intent: Open with exactly: "A car ran me off the road in Florida." and say nothing else in that first turn. Give the other driver, the date, and the account only when asked. Your own name is Martin Iwu; Landry Vance is the other driver, never you. Other driver Landry Vance. May second, twenty twenty six. Short account: he drifted into my lane and forced me off the road. Decline booking. Do not say thank you or end the call on a filing deadline, a date question, or a next-steps speech. Stay until they confirm the intake is recorded on the file. A spoken promise, a filing deadline, or next-steps talk, without that write, is not enough. Once they confirm the intake is recorded on the file, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." and end the call. The agent often says one moment or let me pull you up and then asks a question in the same turn. Always answer the question at the end of the agent's turn with the fact it asks for. Never reply with only "Sure", "Okay", "Yeah", or "Thank you" when the agent's turn ends in a question.

parameters.summary: Run off the road by another driver.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.

The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, whether any attorney represents you, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone, even when the same turn starts with a filler such as one moment, let me pull you up, let me look you up, or I'll check that. NOT any other question.

The agent asks who the claim or matter would be against, who the other side is, or for the name of the other driver or person this would be against, even when the same turn starts with a filler such as one moment, let me pull you up, let me look you up, or I'll check that. NOT when asking you to spell your own name. NOT when asking whether Landry Vance is you or the other driver. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.
The agent asks when the incident happened, or for the date of the accident, injury or event. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was May second, twenty twenty six.

scripted_responses.response_value: He drifted into my lane and forced me off the road.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks whether you want to book a case evaluation, a free evaluation, or an appointment. NOT when confirming intake is recorded.
scripted_responses.response_value: No thank you. I just need the intake on file.

scripted_responses.response_value: I still need the intake on the file.

scripted_responses.response_value: Thank you, that's all I needed.

scripted_responses.response_value: My name is Martin Iwu. Martin, M-A-R-T-I-N. Iwu, I-W-U.
